description: This file defines a React functional component named Sidebar, which renders a collapsible sidebar navigation menu with submenus, user profile info, and responsive behavior. It includes internal state management for sidebar collapse and submenu activation, and uses React Router for navigation.

methods.name: toggleSidebar
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the sidebar and resets active submenu.

methods.name: toggleSubmenu
methods.description: Toggles the active submenu based on index.
